### Template acceptance checks

- [ ] settings.mcs.yml preserves initialized identity, target environment, language, and cli-copilot authoring mode.
- [ ] Every advertised capability maps to the corresponding packaged skill and strict operation schema.
- [ ] Exactly two synthetic knowledge files are present and no live patient data is included.
- [ ] All four locked persona cases route to the expected agent and preserve evidence uncertainty and human review.
- [ ] No diagnosis, treatment, eligibility, authorization outcome, scheduling, outreach, submission, or record-write action is configured; publish remains separately approved.

Source: [catalog acceptance contract](../../../solutions/catalog.json).
